parameters.content:
## 🌐 Public pages served by n8n
Activate this workflow, then these URLs work:
- `https://<n8n>/webhook/privacy`
- `https://<n8n>/webhook/terms`
- `https://<n8n>/webhook/<TIKTOK_VERIFY_FILENAME>`

In the TikTok portal verify the URL prefix `https://<n8n>/webhook/` with the signature file: paste its name and content into **Config**.

assignments.name: PRIVACY_HTML
assignments.value:
Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2026-11-11

Fitness Factory is a personal automation tool operated by Morvalo. It publishes fitness videos to the operator's own TikTok account only.

Data we access

Through the TikTok API we access only the operator's own account: basic profile information and the ability to upload and publish videos.

Data we store

OAuth tokens are stored privately by the operator to keep the integration working. No data about other TikTok users is collected, stored, or shared.

Third parties

We do not sell or share any data with third parties.

Contact

Questions: open an issue at github.com/Morvalo/fitness-factory-legal.

assignments.name: TERMS_HTML
assignments.value:
Terms of Service

Last updated: 2026-11-11

Fitness Factory is a private automation tool used by its operator (Morvalo) to create and publish fitness education videos to the operator's own TikTok account.

The tool is not offered to the public. Use of the published content is subject to TikTok's own Terms of Service.

Content is educational and does not constitute medical advice.

Contact: github.com/Morvalo/fitness-factory-legal.
